items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: Oh, we had one regular Sunday night job, B. St. Paul.

ctx.x: Well, when you were playing with Buddy and George and so on, over, when you came over here for a short time, whereabouts did you play?
Oh, we had one regular Sunday night job, B. St. Paul. That's, just before you get, it was, just before you get into Jefferson Parish. Yeah. Just on the other side of the 17th Street Canal.
